name: Creative Director
about: The Creative Director office's MARK IV agent, moved whole: its canvas (the hero, its card, its words, what a replica is), and on a RUN the chain's sanity (each agent's skills and rules into its job, read by the Claude reader when a program changed) and the X board of the day, HEALTHY or CRITICAL.
reads: its own programs and the office's settings (its folder), its shells table (LARRYD RUNTIME INTERNAL data/creative_director)
LARRYD's records under SYSTEM through the platform's one pipeline: its agents' cards, jobs and logs (written: each agent's skills and rules on its job)
the knowledge store's skills index and the platform's hero lines and version (wid config.json, engine.json)
the Claude reader (claude -p, read only) on a program whose rule changed

card.pitch: Leads the creative side, and is the voice that reads every standup.
